prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Customize Your Pet's Personality", "Select core behavioral traits and color accents for your new desktop companion.", "Personality Trait", "Confirm Pet Traits"]
1: ["Try Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Practice moving, minimizing, and interacting with your pet right on your screen.", "Try dragging your pet | Click to talk | Press Esc to hide", "Complete Setup"]
2: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Display", "Verifying screen overlay permissions and rendering engine status.", "Rendering pet graphics and desktop overlay...", "Display permissions OK | GPU render buffer ready | Sound system loaded"]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Story", "Discover how desktop pets live on your screen, help you focus, and keep you company.", "Choose My Journey"]
4: ["Signing in secures your pet to cloud backup. Your pet state will never reset when reinstalling or signing back in."]
5: ["For best pet generation: Use clear, bright lighting with a single subject facing forward."]
6: ["Desktop Pet Essential Controls", "Double-click pet to talk | Drag to move around screen | Right-click for options menu", "You can change control shortcuts anytime in app settings."]
7: ["We'll play a gentle sound and desktop notice when your pet is ready to appear."]
8: ["Select Your Desktop Companion Mode", "Choose Interactive Companion for games and chat, or Quiet Observer for subtle work background presence."]
9: ["Unlock Exclusive Pet Crown Item"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions exclusive item unlocks, creating scarcity or implying free extras
